sentences.text: 30.03.2026 Issue notice making it returnable on 04.05.2026.

2. Mr. A. Bhattacharyya, the learned counsel accepts notice on behalf of the respondent No.1 and Mr. N. Das, the learned Page No.# 3/4 counsel accepts notice on behalf of the respondent Nos.2, 3 &
4.
Extra copies of the writ petition be served upon them during the course of the day.

3. The grievance of the petitioners herein is that the land of the petitioners has been acquired under the provisions of the Assam Land (Requisition and Acquisition) Act' 1964 and the payment of the compensation has not been made to the petitioners.

4. This Court finds it relevant to take note of Annexure-4 to the writ petition wherein a representation was submitted to the Deputy Commissioner, Kamrup (Metro) wherein the petitioners have sought for payment of the compensation after dividing the same into four parts and to distribute.

It is the case of the petitioners that after submission of the said representation, no effective steps have been taken and it is under such circumstances that the writ petition was filed on 17.02.2026.
5.
The record reveals that this Court had sought for certain instructions from Mr. N. Das, the learned counsel who appears on behalf of the respondent Nos.2, 3 & 4.

In pursuance to that, an instruction has been placed before this Court to the effect that effective steps are being taken, but on account of the announcement of the Model Code of Conduct and the ongoing Page No.# 4/4 elections to be held to the Legislative Assembly of the State of Assam, there has been certain delay,
but in all likelihood the compensation would be paid to the petitioners on or before 24.04.2026.

6. Taking into account the said instructions so placed, this Court observes that the pendency of the instant proceedings shall not be a bar on the part of the respondents to disburse the compensation to the petitioners as well as the others who are entitled to, taking into account that only two persons have approached this Court and the representation so submitted specifically mentions that the compensation is required to be disbursed amongst four persons.

In the circumstance, if the amount is not disbursed on or before the next date, the respondents shall bring on record their stand as to why the amount has not been disbursed and further who would be responsible for the delay so that appropriate orders can be passed in that regard.
7. List accordingly.
